stories.snippet:
Julien Le Bras, the CEO of one of the firms charged with rebuilding Notre 
Dame's spire and its base, told French President Emmanuel Macron that he 
and his fellow artisans worked to restore one of the most iconic pieces of 
the cathedral.

stories.title: How to visit Notre Dame Cathedral?
stories.snippet:
When can I visit Notre-Dame de Paris? You can visit the cathedral as soon 
as it reopens. Visitors must register online free of charge to then take 
advantage of a redesigned and facilitated tour route. A mobile application 
is due to be launched at the beginning of December 2024.

stories.title: Has the Notre Dame Cathedral been restored?
stories.snippet:
French President Emmanuel Macron has toured Paris's Notre-Dame cathedral 
live on TV, giving the public a first look inside the building since much 
of it was destroyed or damaged in a huge fire in 2019. From the spire to 
the stained glass, it has been completely transformed.

stories.title: Is Notre Dame rebuilt?
stories.snippet:
Paris — After more than five years of frenetic reconstruction work, Notre 
Dame cathedral showed its new self to the world Friday, with rebuilt 
soaring ceilings and creamy good-as-new stonework erasing somber memories 
of its devastating fire in 2019.
